label: Motion
lead: Spring physics for switching windows and workspaces. Pick a preset, watch the live preview, then swipe with three fingers and the tiles follow.
features: Five presets, drawn as their curves
Spring, Glide, Snappy, Lively and Reduced. Tune duration, bounce and workspace slide, with a focus fade for the arriving window.
A live preview with stills of your own windows. Hold Compare to see stock Omarchy, or play one real step on your desktop.
Pick a trackpad setup: windows and workspaces, side to side, or up and down. Share a motion with a code like TT1-290-15-30-1.
